page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 virtual CPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading, and 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, operating on the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the instance delivers modest compute performance. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, alongside Geekbench scores, place the CPU performance in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth for large block write operations is average, though read-only memory bandwidth remains weak. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as single-threaded gzip compression, perform poorly, while LLM inference speeds are average for small models but drop to poor for medium 7B models.

Given its hardware profile, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require a substantial local SSD storage footprint without demanding high-performance CPU capabilities or high network throughput. The 959 GB of local SSD storage makes it suitable for local databases, caching layers, and general-purpose applications with moderate I/O requirements.
